title: Settings
description: Local environment, security, access and automation for this vmui host.

access.title: Access
access.hint: API keys, SSH keys, host pins

codai.title: codai
codai.description: Turn any VM vmui manages into a codai Environment (BYO). vmui stays local; codai only sees the daemon's outbound connection.
codai.intro: Create an API key in the codai console (codai_…). It is encrypted at rest with the vmui master key and never shown again — only its prefix and length.
codai.gatewayUrlHint: Environments API base. Leave the default unless you self-host codai.
codai.apiKeyStored: Stored: {prefix} ({length} chars). Paste a new key to replace it.
codai.apiKeyReplace: Paste a new key to replace
codai.testOk: Connected — {count, plural, =0 {no projects yet} one {# project} other {# projects}}
codai.clearHint: Linked environments keep working; vmui just cannot provision or poll until a key is added again.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: How this vmui instance is wired.
environment.masterKeyHint: AES-256-GCM. Encrypts every cloud credential at rest. Lose it and every account must be re-added — generate a new one with <cmd>pnpm keygen</cmd>.

telemetry.title: Inventory
telemetry.description: What vmui knows about your fleet.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Theme, accent and density are per browser.
appearance.hint: Use the palette icon in the top bar to change these.
appearance.localeHint: Switch with the language button in the top bar.

pwa.title: App & notifications
pwa.description: Install vmui to your home screen and get push notifications for VM, build and alert events.
pwa.pushHint: Requires VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY and optional VAPID_SUBJECT in .env. Generate with pnpm dlx web-push generate-vapid-keys.

providers.title: Cloud providers
providers.description: Plug-and-play registry. Disabled providers are on the roadmap.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Navigate vmui without leaving the keyboard.

password.title: Password
password.description: Change the password you sign in with. Every other browser signed in as you is signed out.
password.changedHint: This session stays signed in; all others are revoked.

errors.same: New password must differ from the current one

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with Touch ID, Windows Hello or a hardware key instead of a password.
passkeys.emptyHint: Add one to skip the password on sign-in.
passkeys.label: Label
passkeys.confirmRemoveHint: You can still sign in with your password or another passkey.

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.description: A second factor so a stolen password is not enough to sign in.
totp.offHint: Works with Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, Bitwarden and any TOTP app.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.step1: 1. Scan the QR code with your authenticator.
totp.backupRemaining: {count, plural, =1 {# backup code} other {# backup codes}} remaining
totp.saveCodesHint: Each code works once. Keep them in your password manager — they replace the old codes.
totp.testPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator
totp.testOk: Code matches — your authenticator is in sync.
totp.regeneratePrompt: Confirm your password to regenerate backup codes

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Every browser signed in to this vmui. Revoke the ones you do not recognise.
sessions.count: {count, plural, =1 {# active session} other {# active sessions}}
sessions.revokedOthers: {count, plural, =1 {Revoked # other session} other {Revoked # other sessions}}

users.title: Users
users.description: Local accounts for the VM control plane and what each may do.
users.hubHint: Roles here govern the control plane only. Who may see or control rooms at home is a separate model.
users.familyHint: Owner, adult, child and guest — with per-room grants — live under Home → Settings → Family.
users.disabledHint: Create the first admin to turn on sign-in.
users.confirmDeleteHint: Their sessions and passkeys are removed. Cloud resources they created are untouched.

resetPassword.title: Reset password for {email}
resetPassword.description: Their current password stops working and every session of theirs is signed out.
resetPassword.doneHint: Share it with them over a secure channel — it will not be shown again.

errors.self: Use “Change password” in Security for your own account

legend.title: Roles
legend.admin: manages users, keys and everything else

create.title: Add a user
create.description: The new user can sign in right away with the role you pick.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Bearer tokens for the public /api/v1 surface.
apiKeys.usage: Send as Authorization: Bearer KEY. Operator keys may mutate, viewer keys are read-only.
apiKeys.createDescription: The secret is shown once, right after creation.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.scopesHint: What this key may do over MCP. Leave everything unchecked for an unrestricted key.

presetHints.stream: For TikSee and stream agents: scenes, colour flashes, ambilight mode and the RGB room lights only (moodlight, ambience, MELK strip, ambilight). Effects are rate-limited per key.

apiKeys.scopeEntitiesHint: Limits lights, switches, climate, media and Nest Hub tools. Tick from the catalog or paste ids separated by commas.
apiKeys.scopeScriptsHint: Script names ha_script may run, separated by commas. Empty = any script.

scopeSummary.pc: {count, plural, =1 {# PC action} other {# PC actions}}

apiKeys.created: API key created — copy it now
apiKeys.issuedHint: Copy it now — it will not be shown again.
apiKeys.confirmRevokeHint: Requests using it will fail immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.emptyHint: Create one to call /api/v1 from scripts and CI.

sshKeys.title: SSH keys
sshKeys.description: Stored in vmui.db, encrypted with your master key. The public half is injected at create-time for Azure, GCP and Scaleway; AWS uses provider-side keypairs.
sshKeys.hubDescription: Stored, generated and exported as ~/.ssh/config snippets.
sshKeys.name: Name
sshKeys.generatedHint: Share this with the cloud provider.
sshKeys.emptyHint: Import a key or generate one above.
sshKeys.confirmDeleteHint: Existing VMs using it remain accessible — only vmui forgets it.

config.title: ~/.ssh/config snippet
config.description: Ready-made host entries for every reachable Linux VM.
config.emptyHint: Once an instance has a public IP it will appear here.
config.header: Generated by vmui — drop in ~/.ssh/config or include via 'Include ~/.ssh/config.d/vmui'

knownHosts.title: SSH known hosts
knownHosts.description: The SSH bridge pins each server's host key on first connect. A changed fingerprint refuses the connection — forget a pin only when you rotated the server's key on purpose.
knownHosts.emptyHint: Open any SSH session and the fingerprint is recorded automatically.
knownHosts.confirmForgetHint: The next SSH connection will accept whatever fingerprint the server presents and pin it again.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Forward instance and snapshot events to Slack, Discord or any HTTPS endpoint.
webhooks.emptyHint: Add one to get notified when instances change state.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.confirmDeleteHint: Events stop flowing to this endpoint immediately.

bootScripts.title: Boot scripts
bootScripts.description: User-data passed verbatim to the provider at instance creation. Pick one in the create form; vmui never runs them locally.
bootScripts.emptyHint: Add cloud-init, bash or PowerShell to run on first boot.
bootScripts.name: Name
bootScripts.confirmDeleteHint: Instances already created with it are not affected.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: Mute non-critical notifications during a daily window.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.description: Signed JSON of all accounts and SSH keys. Credentials stay encrypted with your master key — restore on the same key on another host to migrate.
backup.overwriteHint: Otherwise rows with the same id are skipped.
backup.restored: Restored {accounts, plural, =1 {# account} other {# accounts}}, {keys, plural, =1 {# key} other {# keys}}
